from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test R02: LRU eviction must not leave stale memberships
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c.put('b', 2, ['x'])
assert c.invalidate('x') == 2  # removes both
assert c._tags.get('x') is None  # tag entry fully cleaned up

# Now test: put 'a' again after eviction, then evict via LRU
c2 = TaggedCache(2)
c2.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c2.put('b', 2, ['x'])
c2.put('c', 3, ['y'])  # evicts 'a'
assert 'a' not in c2  # 'a' was evicted
assert c2.invalidate('x') == 1  # only 'b' remains with tag 'x'
print('LRU eviction tag cleanup works')

# Test R03: maxsize property
c3 = TaggedCache(5)
assert c3.maxsize == 5
c3.maxsize = 10
assert c3.maxsize == 10
print('maxsize property works')

# Test R03: invalid replacement input leaves old value unchanged
c4 = TaggedCache(5)
c4.put('a', 1, ['x'])
try:
    c4.maxsize = True
except ValueError:
    pass
assert c4.maxsize == 5
assert c4.get('a') == 1
print('Invalid maxsize replacement preserves state')
